lighting.type: Mixed architectural: concealed cove strips, recessed downlights, theatrical saturated accent wash, and full-spectrum LED overheads
lighting.direction: Omnidirectional with dominant upward cove bounce and overhead downlight fill; isolated theatrical spaces use full-envelope color flood
lighting.quality: Bimodal — majority of frames render soft, diffused warmth with gentle highlight rolloff and lifted shadows; minority of frames apply hard monochromatic saturation with crushed blacks and zero fill

grain.film_stock: none — clean digital capture or CGI render; no luminance noise or chroma grain present across the set

atmosphere: architectural highlight rolloff on curved surfaces and vaulted ceilings
warm atmospheric bloom emanating from concealed cove sources
full-envelope monochromatic color cast in theatrical volumes (crimson, cyan, deep cobalt)
crushed blacks in high-drama spaces with near-zero shadow recovery
reflective floor doubling — polished stone and lacquer surfaces creating symmetrical light pools
glass-panel color temperature contrast — warm amber exterior bleeding against cool-cast interior rooms
subtle vignetting in smaller-format architectural crops
neon edge-light halo and inter-reflection off grid-textured wall panels
point-light scatter creating luminous dot fields in the deep-blue immersive space
clean clinical overexposure in white-box tech retail versus rich underlighting in luxury warm volumes
style_summary: The moodboard exhibits a deliberate bifurcation between two photographic registers unified by an absence of grain and a deep-focus architectural lens. The dominant register — spanning the majority of the set — employs concealed cove lighting and warm tungsten-balanced sources to produce soft highlight rolloff over cream, amber, and terracotta surfaces, with lifted blacks, muted tonal contrast, and a gold-champagne color cast that reads as restrained opulence. The second register deploys theatrical full-envelope color saturation — monochromatic crimson, saturated cyan-teal, and deep cobalt-blue — with crushed shadows, reflective floor doubling, and point-light scatter to create immersive, high-drama volumes. Across both registers, the lens vocabulary is consistent: wide-angle rectilinear capture at f/5.6–f/8 maintains deep focus with minimal geometric distortion, emphasizing volumetric depth and spatial scale. The result is a photographic language that oscillates between warm editorial interiors and scenographic color-field installations, always prioritizing tonal precision and spatial authority over documentary realism.
